# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary architecture and analysis documents generated during the application assessment.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level application architecture and detailed component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - External dependency inventory grouped by functional category.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - HTTP endpoint catalog, communication patterns, and service contract summary.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Database configuration, ER diagram, repository methods, and data sensitivity notes.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, profiles, properties, secrets handling, and runtime versions.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Core domain workflows, business rules, and primary workflow sequence.
